reported.title: Toggles on release edge and lacks debounce, causing multiple toggles per press
reported.description: The firmware toggles on a rising (LOW-to-HIGH) edge via risingEdge() at lines 26-29 and 54-57, but the key is active LOW, so a press is a falling edge and the toggle actually fires on release. There is no 40 ms settle/debounce logic anywhere in loop() (lines 50-66), so contact bounce produces many spurious edges: measured toggle counts per press were [2,2,3,...] for rapid presses, [3,3,3,3] for bounce, and [5] for the 20 ms long-bounce case, plus 9/16/6 unexplained toggles. 15 of 15 press(es) did not toggle D13 exactly once; toggle counts per press were [2, 2, 3, 2, 2, 3, 3, 2, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2]. D13 also toggled 9 time(s) with no press to explain it, first at 952 ms.

judge_input.spec:
- Panel key on D2 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); status LED on D13.
- Each settled press toggles D13 exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce up to 20 ms on press and release must not produce extra toggles.
- Use a 40 ms settle window before accepting a press edge (HIGH-to-LOW after settle).
- Print `panel led=<0|1> edges=<n>` every 1000 ms.
- Idle (unpressed) key reads HIGH.
